item.text: I’ll take this pass as another incremental quality improvement rather than a wholesale project reshuffle. The useful remaining area is the test harness: make assertions reusable, reduce duplicated try/catch logic, and add a couple of edge cases around single-character searches and empty text.

The production class is already reasonably compact, so I’m focusing this round on making the tests easier to extend and broadening the edge-case coverage. That gives future refactors a better safety net without adding dependencies.
The test harness now uses shared helpers and includes additional edge cases for empty text, empty pattern, and single-character matches. I’m compiling and running everything again.
